user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a ripe pineapple. A ripe pineapple with a slightly asymmetric ovoid body covered in a diamond grid of raised hexagonal 'eyes', and a spreading crown of stiff, pointed serrated green leaves at the top. Grocery-store fruit look, golden-brown body. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
